Research Question¶

Does the use of generative AI help students in their learning process and their academic performance?

    "0-5 min",
    "5-10 min",

    "15-20 min",

    "25-30 min"
]

In [372]:
# Pipeline Building

gpa_transformer = Pipeline([("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median", add_indicator=True))])

session_transformer = Pipeline([("onehot", OneHotEncoder())])

survey_encoder = OrdinalEncoder(
    categories=[
        q1_order,
        q2_order,
        q4_order,
    ],
    handle_unknown="use_encoded_value",
    unknown_value=np.nan
)


survey_transformer = Pipeline([
    ("ordinal", survey_encoder)
])

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ("gpa", gpa_transformer, gpa_features),
    ("session", session_transformer, categorical_features),
    ("survey", survey_transformer, survey_features),
    ("continuous", "passthrough", continuous_features),
    ("binary", "passthrough", binary_features),
    ("ordinal", "passthrough", ordinal_features)    
])

linear_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ("preprocessor", preprocessor),
    ("model", LinearRegression())
])

Model Building and Selection¶

# Cross Valdiation 5-fold

cv_results = cross_validate(
    linear_pipeline,
    X,
    y,
    groups=groups,
    cv=group_cv,
    scoring={
        "r2": "r2",
        "mae": "neg_mean_absolute_error",
        "mse": "neg_mean_squared_error"
    },
    return_train_score=True
)

models = {
    "Dummy": DummyRegressor(strategy="mean"),

    "Linear Regression": LinearRegression(),

    "Ridge": Ridge(alpha=1.0),

    "Random Forest": RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=300,
        random_state=42
    ),

    "Gradient Boosting": GradientBoostingRegressor(
        random_state=42
    )
}
In [ ]:
# Checking different models and seeing which is best

results = []

for name, model in models.items():

    pipeline = Pipeline([
        ("preprocessor", preprocessor),
        ("model", model)
    ])

    scores = cross_validate(
        pipeline,
        X,
        y,
        groups=groups,
        cv=group_cv,
        scoring={
            "r2": "r2",
            "mae": "neg_mean_absolute_error",
            "mse": "neg_mean_squared_error"
        }
    )

    r2 = scores["test_r2"]
    mae = -scores["test_mae"]
    rmse = np.sqrt(-scores["test_mse"])

    results.append({
        "Model": name,
        "R2": r2.mean(),
        "MAE": mae.mean(),
        "RMSE": rmse.mean(),
    })

In [378]:
# After choosing Gradient Boost, now were are hyperparameter tuning to improve the model even more

gb_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ("preprocessor", preprocessor),
    ("model", GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42))
])

param_grid = {
    "model__n_estimators": [50, 100, 150, 200, 250],
    "model__learning_rate": [0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.1],
    "model__max_depth": [2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
    "model__min_samples_leaf": [1, 5, 10]
}

grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    estimator=gb_pipeline,
    param_grid=param_grid,
    scoring="neg_root_mean_squared_error",
    cv=group_cv,
    n_jobs=-1,
    return_train_score=True
)

grid_search.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    groups=groups_train
)

print("Best Parameters:")
print(grid_search.best_params_)

print()

print("Best CV RMSE:")
print(-grid_search.best_score_)

# Runnign final model against test set

final_model = grid_search.best_estimator_

y_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)

test_r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_pred)
test_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred)
test_rmse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred) ** 0.5

print(f"Test R²:   {test_r2:.4f}")
print(f"Test MAE:  {test_mae:.4f}")
print(f"Test RMSE: {test_rmse:.4f}")
